hero.title: 8isomalt

overview.title: Outperforms Traditional Sweeteners
overview.desc: Isomalt uniquely combines metabolic safety, industrial stability, and clean-label consumer acceptance. A natural, short-chain prebiotic fiber with multifunctional benefits

margin.title: High Gross Margin
margin.desc: Commodity sugar is upgraded into high-value functional ingredients—for example, $1/kg sugar converted into isomalt sold at $8/kg with $3/kg processing cost generates $4/kg profit (~50% gross margin).

production.title: Efficient Production
production.desc: Optimized enzyme systems and crystallization processes enable high product yield and process efficiency.

scale.title: Scalable Manufacturing
scale.desc: Industrial processes such as concentration, crystallization, centrifugation, and drying support large-scale production capacity.

cards.desc: Widely used in carbonated and ready-to-drink beverages.

cards.title: Food Product Use

cards.title: Pharmaceutical Formulation
cards.desc: Used in sugar-free syrups and medicinal products.

hero.title: Fructooligosaccharides (FOS)
hero.subtitle: Transforming commodity sucrose into functional carbohydrates

overview.title: A Precision Prebiotic Solution
overview.desc: Engineered to selectively nourish beneficial gut bacteria. A natural, short-chain prebiotic fiber with multifunctional benefits

microbiome.title: Targeted Microbiome Activation
microbiome.desc: FOS selectively stimulates beneficial bacteria such as Bifidobacteria, improving gut ecosystem balance. This leads to measurable digestive and immune benefits.

fiber.title: Fast-Acting Functional Fiber
fiber.desc: Due to its short-chain structure, FOS is rapidly fermented in the colon. This allows quicker physiological response compared to longer-chain fibers.

integration.title: Seamless Product Integration
integration.desc: Its high solubility and mild sweetness make it easy to incorporate into beverages, dairy, and supplements without compromising taste.

coreAdvantage.title: Strong Unit Economics with Scalable Upside

model.title: Efficient Production Model
model.desc: Enzymatic conversion from sucrose enables scalable and consistent manufacturing. This reduces supply chain volatility.

density.title: High Value Density
density.desc: Small inclusion levels deliver significant functional benefits. This allows premium pricing without heavily impacting product cost.

margin.title: Margin Expansion Lever
margin.desc: FOS enhances product positioning (gut health, low sugar), enabling higher retail pricing. Brands can improve margins while maintaining competitiveness.

cards.title: Functional Beverages
cards.desc: Includes ready-to-drink gut health beverages, fiber drinks, and low-sugar formulations.

cards.title: Dairy & Dairy Alternatives
cards.desc: Yogurt, probiotic drinks, and plant-based dairy increasingly incorporate prebiotics like FOS.

cards.title: Dietary Supplements
cards.desc: Capsules, powders, and sachets targeting gut health and immunity

overview.title: Enzymatic Conversion Unlocks Scalable Production
overview.desc: Transforming abundant Reb A into premium Reb M through biotechnology

conversion.title: Reb A Conversion Strategy
conversion.desc: Abundant and low-cost Reb A is enzymatically converted into high-value Reb M through targeted glycosylation.

controlled.title: Controlled Production System
controlled.desc: Biocatalytic processes enable precise control over reaction conditions, ensuring consistent product quality.

scalable.title: Scalable Biotech Approach
scalable.desc: Production is decoupled from agricultural limitations, enabling industrial-scale manufacturing.

cost.title: Cost-Efficient Output
cost.desc: High conversion efficiency and optimized inputs significantly reduce cost per unit of Reb M.

coreAdvantage.title: Why Reb M is Important & Cost Effective
coreAdvantage.tableCaption: Traditional stevia components such as Reb A have a bitter aftertaste.

raw.title: Low-Cost Raw Material
raw.desc: Reb A is significantly cheaper and more abundant than Reb M. This makes it an ideal substrate for large-scale conversion.

yield.title: Efficient Conversion Yield
yield.desc: High conversion rates (>80–97%) maximize production output. This allows more Reb M to be produced from the same input volume.

processing.title: Lower Processing Cost
processing.desc: Simplified purification reduces downstream operational expenses. Fewer impurities lead to less complex separation and lower energy usage.

hero.title: The Future of Early Cancer Detection
hero.subtitle: World's first AI-native, nano-precision platform designed to revolutionize how we detect and treat cancer.
hero.cardBody: A modular platform spanning early screening, surgical navigation, and next-generation therapeutic delivery.

problem.title: Lack Of Precision Leads To Late Detection, Toxic Treatments, And Surgical Guesswork.
problem.subtitle: From missed diagnoses to incomplete surgeries—cancer care demands sharper tools.

gap.title: Precision Gap
gap.desc: Bridging oncology's precision deficit across diagnosis, surgery, and therapy could save millions of lives - and it's a US$400 billion market correction waiting to happen

limitations.title: Conventional Limitations
limitations.desc: "Conventional EPR and ligand-based systems leave over 95% of therapy off target, suffering from poor efficiency, unintended accumulation in healthy organs, and long-term toxicity."

opportunity.title: Clinical Opportunity
opportunity.desc: GTTNano targets the tumor cell nucleus for earlier signal, cleaner margins, and higher-value interventions across the care pathway.

showcase.title: A New Era of Nano-Precision
showcase.subtitle: Unlike traditional EPR or ligand-based systems, GTTN leverages a novel Cell Membrane Permeability Targeting (CMPT) mechanism—allowing it to penetrate tumor cells selectively and accumulate in the nucleus with unmatched precision.

detection.title: Ultra-sensitive early detection
detection.desc: Higher signal fidelity for detecting malignant changes before symptoms become obvious.

navigation.title: Real-time fluorescence navigation
navigation.desc: Sharper intraoperative guidance for defining margins and identifying metastatic spread.

delivery.title: High-efficiency, low-toxicity delivery
delivery.desc: More of the payload reaches malignant tissue while minimizing systemic exposure.

rows.ligand: Specific binding between ligand and receptor

rows.cmpt: No significant accumulation in normal tissues
rows.epr: Remains in liver/kidney for several months or even years

cellSafe.title: Cell Safe
cellSafe.desc: In vitro tests show no significant toxicity to living cells, even at high concentrations and long exposure times.

systemic.title: No Systemic Toxicity
systemic.desc: After intravenous injection, GTTN showed no harmful effects on organ function, reproduction, or blood chemistry.

hepatic.title: No Hepatotoxicity
hepatic.desc: Liver function remains normal, confirming excellent biocompatibility in large animal models.

environment.title: No Environmental Toxicity
environment.desc: Zebrafish embryo tests revealed no developmental or ecological toxicity.

omics.title: New Biology, New Omics
omics.desc: TransCellOmics: 1st AI-driven permeability database and predictive model.

generative.title: Generative AI Meets Nanodesign
generative.desc: Combining GTTNano's flexible synthesis capabilities with AI for high value products.

dimension.title: A new dimension of multi-omics
dimension.desc: Introducing real-time, spatially resolved data on cell membrane permeability.
